errorCorrection.title: Find the mistake
errorCorrection.subtitle: Each sentence has exactly one mistake. Tap the word you think is wrong. Twenty original sentences.

items.message: Was/were mistake: 'my friends' (they) takes 'were', not 'was'.
Was/were mistake: 'the birds' (they) takes 'were', not 'was'.
A background action in progress needs was/were + -ing — 'was texting', not just 'texting'.
An action in progress at that moment needs was/were + -ing — 'were climbing', not just 'climbing'.
The past continuous needs was/were before the -ing form — 'were still hiking', not just 'still hiking'.
The short interrupting action takes the past simple, not the continuous — 'cut', not 'was cutting'.
After 'was', use the -ing form — 'playing', not 'play'.
State verbs like 'belong' never take the continuous — use the past simple, 'belonged'.
State verbs like 'believe' stay in the past simple, even in the negative — 'didn't believe'.
Double the final consonant — 'stopping', not 'stoping'.

Change 'ie' to 'y' before adding -ing — 'dying', not 'dieing'.
Was/were mistake: 'the girls' (they) takes 'were', not 'was'.
Was/were mistake: 'your dad' (he) takes 'was', not 'were'.
The negative past continuous needs wasn't/weren't — 'weren't having', not 'not having'.
Was/were mistake: 'Kate' (she) takes 'was', not 'were'.
The short interrupting action takes the past simple — 'hit', not the -ing form alone.
The background action needs was/were + -ing — 'was carrying', not just 'carrying'.

State verbs like 'contain' never take the continuous — use the past simple, 'contained'.
